'''Glowbugs''' were a type of [[Insect/Legends|insect]] found on<ref name="COTJ" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. While on Belsavis<ref name="COTJ" /> in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]],<ref name="TERC-COTJ">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']] to [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] noticed some glowbugs flying alongside [[Moth/Legends|moths]] in the light of [[Lamp/Legends|streetlamps]] and [[Viewport/Legends|windows]] at [[Local day/Legends|night]].<ref name="COTJ" /> During her search for the [[Sith Saber]] [[Querdan Dei]] on<ref name="Conviction" /> the Outer Rim<ref name="TEA" /> planet [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]]<ref name="Conviction" /> in [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC-Conviction">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the [[Gender/Legends|girl]] [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]] compared her search to the difficulty of finding an individual glowbug, reflecting that they were easier to find in small groups flying over [[Water/Legends|ponds]] rather than in large [[Cloud/Legends|clouds]] in [[City/Legends|cities]].<ref name="Conviction" />

==Behind the scenes==
Glowbugs first appeared in the [[1995]] novel [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']], written by [[Barbara Hambly]].<ref name="COTJ" />
